title: Infinite families of very exotic spheres with free $S^1$- and $S^3$-actions
summary: There are two kinds of exotic spheres: bp spheres, which bound parallelizable manifolds, and non-bp spheres, or very exotic spheres, which do not. In the 1960s, W.-C. Hsiang showed that in each dimension where bp spheres exist, there is at least one which admits infinitely many inequivalent smooth free $S^1$-actions, and in each dimension congruent to $3$ modulo $4$, there is at least one bp sphere which admits infinitely many inequivalent smooth free $S^3$-actions.
